workflow_notes: The render is tilted ~35-45 deg (p4-env-concept-sb3): the hedge face and ha-ha face show as elevations. Hedge and coping are placed on their ground-contact lines (hedge foot y=0.267, coping inner edge y=0.605 where the drawn grass ends; layout.json haha_mid y=0.64 lies on the coping band); the hedge top and the ha-ha face bands in the image lie outside the modelled footprints; inferred:true.

The grass strip reads ~4.4 m deep vs 8 m in architecture because of the tilt. Kept image/layout geometry so the ground plate is not distorted; the Gryphon's full wingspan may overlap the hedge foot or coping in wide shots, whitebox-staging should check the CGI griffin bounds against the 4.4 m depth.

Ha-ha drop: the whitebox ground is flat, so the lower ground (1.5 m below, south of the coping) is not modelled. Routes must stay north of the coping (image y < 0.605). layout.json view 7 (camera from lower_ground up the wall face) cannot be staged in this asset; if a shot needs it, request a separate lower-level scene asset from the director rather than lowering this one.
The ha-ha is drawn running the full width, so the coping spans the whole map; haha_east_end (x 0.95) is a point on it, not a wall end.

Anti-clipping: the yew arch clears 1.8 m wide x 2.4 m high — Alice (1.35 m) passes freely; the CGI Gryphon must fold its wings and pass low or be staged entering from out of frame. The gate pier stands on the coping line; the grass strip is otherwise open.
